stem: Direction: Two statements are given. Statement-2 is purported to be the explanation for Statement-1. Statement-1: Angular velocity of body A with respect to another body B is always given by ω A − ω B = ω AB , where ω A and ω B are angular velocities of the two rotating bodies. Statement-2: Velocity of body A with respect to another body B is v A − v B . (a) S-1 true, S-2 true; S-2 is the correct explanation for S-1 (b) S-1 true, S-2 true; S-2 is not a correct explanation for S-1 (c) S-1 true; S-2 false (d) S-1 false; S-2 true
